{{Quote|All my hideaways are being monitored. As I am. But awhile back I hired a look-alike, and my surveillance follows him home. Meaning I can sometimes walk around freely.|Denjax Teppler|<ref name="Exile" />}}
In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> an individual served as a look-alike<ref name="Exile" /> '''body double''' of [[Denjax Teppler]], the [[Minister of Justice (Five Worlds)|Minister of Justice]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|231|Teppler, Denjax}}</ref> Teppler was a dark-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] whose features were considered by others to be bland yet handsome<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref> and confidence-inspiring.<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref> He was hired by Teppler so the latter could protect himself<ref name="CSWE" /> when other [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] began to monitor his activities in the midst of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system's]] [[Five Worlds]] government's [[Second Galactic Civil War|war]] with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. The surveillance that had been attached to Teppler sometimes mistakenly followed the look-alike to Teppler's home in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], which allowed the Minister to move about freely.<ref name="Exile" />

==Behind the scenes==
Denjax Teppler's body double was mentioned in [[Aaron Allston]]'s [[2007]] novel [[Legacy of the Force: Exile|''Exile'']], published as the fourth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series.<ref name="Exile" />
